# Neospectra

Near-infrared soil spectral library from selected KSSL samples (USA) and Africa

## Overview

- **Sample size:** 2,000+
- **Version:** second update (v1)
- **Spectral range:** nir
- **Extent:** national

## Soil laboratory information

- **n properties available:** 23
- **n properties standardized:** 23
- **n properties harmonized:** pending
- **properties themes:** physical, chemical, hydrological, carbon & nutrients, metal elements

## Soil site information

- **coordinates precision:** precise, county, country
- **sampling depth:** various
- **geography:** soil taxonomy, soil horizon
